content:
The datasheet defines one **40GBASE-ER4** application with four **per-lane** CWDM wavelength ranges in the same optical table; lane signaling is **10.3125 GBd** (~**10.3 Gbps**). Per-lane TX uses **TXPx −2.7 to 4.5 dBm**; receiver **OMA sensitivity** is **−19 dBm** (stressed **−16.8** is a test condition, not a separate selectable mode). No penalties were supplied to assign.
